<infobox theme="Person">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Biographical information</header>
        <data source="birth"><label>Born</label></data>	
        <data source="death"><label>Died</label></data>	
        <data source="listedpronouns"><label>Listed pronouns</label></data>	
        <data source="nationality"><label>Nationality</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Career</header>
        <data source="occupation"><label>Occupation</label></data>	
        <data source="companies"><label>Companies</label></data>	
        <data source="website"><label>Official website</label></data>	
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Person|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|birth|death|listedpronouns|nationality|occupation|companies|website|ignore=name}}<noinclude>[[category:OOU infobox templates]]

===Usage instructions===
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:
<pre><nowiki>
{{Top|rwp}}
{{Person
|image=
|name=
|birth=
|death=
|listedpronouns=
|nationality=
|occupation=
|companies=
|website=
}}</nowiki></pre>

'''The "listedpronouns" field of the infobox will only be filled if the individual in question has publicly self-identified their pronouns and a valid source is provided.'''

'''The "website" field of the infobox must be formatted as a shortened url, like this: [https://example.com example.com]. However, if the website as a name, such as [[John Jackson Miller]]'s website "Faraday Press", then the field must be formatted like this: [https://farawaypress.com Faraway Press]. If the name of the website is the same name as the entity which is the subject of the article, revert to using a shortened url.'''

{{Interlang
|tr=Şablon:Birey
}}
</noinclude>
